column1: # Public function mutants of deflate, replayed against the exact proof of Goal.deflate
# (Zlib.Deflate.Universal.deflate_safety). Each edits the body of `deflate` in the translation only.
# The semantic mutants of the deflate proof, with paired edits in the proof restatements, are in
# deflate-header.tsv, deflate-strategies.tsv and tests/audit/proofmut/deflate.tsv. A one-file edit of the body
# is first rejected where the proof restates `deflate` as its phases (`deflate_phases`), so these rows show
# that the exact proof does not survive the edit; the semantic evidence is in the lists above. Each edit
# drops a test, so the kernel rejects the restatement quickly; an arithmetic or call change in the
# trailer was tried and made the kernel replay exceed its memory budget instead.

column3: flush > Z_BLOCK || flush < 0 then return Z_STREAM_ERROR
